# GEO + SEO Review

Use this workflow when reviewing or improving this website for search visibility.

## Goals
- Improve discoverability in AI-powered search assistants and traditional search engines.
- Preserve truthful, useful content and avoid keyword stuffing or fabricated authority signals.
- Prefer concrete site improvements over speculative ranking claims.

## Review areas
1. AI citability: clear answers, self-contained factual passages, strong page context, descriptive headings.
2. Brand/entity clarity: consistent school name, location, contact details, official links, and clear About information.
3. AI crawler access: inspect robots.txt for accidental blocking of legitimate search/AI crawlers.
4. llms.txt: recommend or generate only when useful; keep it factual and aligned with the actual site.
5. Structured data: use valid JSON-LD such as Organization/EducationalOrganization, WebSite, BreadcrumbList, FAQ only when content is genuinely present.
6. Technical SEO: title, meta description, canonical, viewport, HTTPS, sitemap, robots.txt, status codes, mobile usability, performance, internal linking.
7. Content quality: accuracy, freshness, clear authorship/ownership where relevant, useful admissions/contact information, no thin duplicate pages.
8. Local discoverability: consistent name/address/phone where public, clear directions/contact pages, descriptive page titles.

## Rules
- Never invent testimonials, awards, accreditations, addresses, ratings, statistics, staff credentials, or schema fields.
- Do not add FAQ schema unless the matching FAQ content is visibly present on the page.
- Do not block or allow crawlers blindly; inspect existing policy first.
- Keep human usability and accessibility ahead of search-engine tricks.
- Explain any significant SEO/GEO change and verify it does not break existing functionality.

## Before delivery
- Check titles and descriptions are unique and relevant.
- Check canonical URLs and sitemap/robots references.
- Validate JSON-LD syntax and ensure it matches visible facts.
- Check mobile layout and page speed basics.
- Check internal links and primary calls to action.
- Summarize what changed, what was verified, and any remaining items requiring business-owner confirmation.

Inspired by the open-source geo-seo-claude workflow from zubair-trabzada/geo-seo-claude.
